summary: Kerb where cars park, but houses sit 11-14 m behind it.

drivers.seclusion: Houses front this kerb; nearest dwellings 9 m (at 0 m) and 11 m (at 28 m), with hedges and trees screening.
drivers.access_and_room: Sealed kerbside lane with several parked cars; room to pull in at the kerb, no gate or barrier.
drivers.traffic: Wide through street with moderate traffic.
drivers.convention: Cars park on this kerb in both images, so a van would not stand out.

flags: Dwellings 10-25 m away on the same side
Steep further north: up to 11% at 95-120 m
Opposite side is bush with a wide dirt verge where cars also park
sun_shade: Hedges and trees shade the kerb from the east; afternoon sun from the west over the road.

best_section.where: East kerb of Taringa Parade, about 15 m north of the southern junction
